selection: minimum mean parent-validation NLL, no final test data generated or evaluated in this mechanism pilot
evaluation: Exact source-parent uniform fixed coordinates retained inside observed SNP coverage of Relate-inferred genealogies. Original query order and global coordinates are preserved. No chromosome-tail extrapolation.
interpretation: Exploratory whole-tree and paper-equation ARGMix adaptations on identical 48-feature inferred parents. No exact reproduction, final-test, performance or novelty claim.
comparison_note: ARGMix v1 paper relative Q/K/V equations with observed ages and whole trees. Secondary nearest-reference CLS scope has24available refs and27-28 biological tokens, differing from the paper29. Generic hop-relative graph Transformer is a distinct family control. Same hidden32/layers2 and optimizer budget, parameter counts differ.

source_parent.split_policy: Same 16 train and4 validation larger-query parents, no test.

inference.seed_scheme: SHA256 UTF-8 ARG-GNN/Relate/v1.2.4/{master_seed}/{split}/{replicate}; first 8 bytes unsigned big endian modulo (2**31-1), plus 1
inference.coverage_policy: [first exported original SNP, last exported original SNP + 1); exact original grid only
inference.genotype_source: Cleaned parent observed.trees.gz only, never raw census truth.
inference.polarization: Simulated ancestral allele at observed mutation sites only; no invented ancestor FASTA
